paite: Zan a ka lupna tung a ka ihmut in, ka mang in ka it ka mu hi; amah ka zongzong a, himahleh ka mu kei.
Ka thou ding a, khopi kim ah ka pai dia, kongzing leh lampi ah, amah ka kha in a-it ka zong ding, ka chi a ka zong hi, himahleh amah muh zoh in a-omta kei.
Khopi a vialpai veng mite'n ahon mu ua; akiang uah, "Amah ka kha in a-it na mu uhia?" ka chi a.
Amaute ka paisan sawt louchik ahi, huan amah ka kha in a-it ka mu hi; ka paisak kei, ka nu insung, hon painu dantan sung a amah ka pilut masiah.
Zuktal leh gam a zukpite in ka hon ngen hi, Aw Jerusalem tanute aw, ka it hihbuai kei unla, phawng kei un, alungkim matan.
Gamdai a kipan a meikhu kitung bang a hong pai murrah leh begaw kinuh a, sumsinmi nuhngou vui kinuh hiai kua ahia?
heading: La Thumna / Numei

paite: Ngai in, Solomon lupna ahi; akim ah mihat sawmguk, Israel mihatte a kipan a-om uh.
Namsau atawi chiat ua, kidouna a kivate ahi uhi. Michih in apheipi tung ah namsau atawi chiat ua, zan a launa ziak in.
Kumpipa Solomon in Lebanon sing in kangtalai akibawl hi.
Huai a khuamte dangka in abawl a, anuai dangka-eng, atutphah asandup, alaizang, Jerusalem tanute a kipan a- itna toh aphah ahi.
Aw nou Zion tanute, pawtkhia unla, kumpipa Solomon en un, azineih ni leh alungtang kipahna ni a, anu'n amah lallukhu akhuksak toh.
